name: UrBackup
description: In the reviewed UrBackup server client-update path, update files are checked with verifyFile using an ECDSA public-key file and a matching .sig2 sidecar; an administrator-configured public-key path can override the default. Deployment-wide transport and default-push behavior remain outside this evidence.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; this source read does not establish the client-push default, transport authentication, or release-specific key distribution.
